info.name: Delete address reference linked to number(s)

items.docs: The method _/numbers/addressReference_. You can retrieve the current address linked to a number by calling the method /numbers/{number}. You can update the address by calling the method _/numbers/addressReferences._ You can retrieve a list of your addresses by calling the method _/addresses._ If the address is mandatory by country specifications, you are not allowed to delete the address.
